source_refs.note: Exercise 9.1, Question 4 (book p. 269); answers on PDF 309 (Answers 9.1)

blocks.prompt: 4 (i) Without using calculator find the value of the following: \(\cos\left(\frac{1}{2}\cot^{-1}\frac{5}{12}\right)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan ek inverse-trig angle ka aadha diya hai. Pehle us poore angle ko naam denge: \(\alpha = \cot^{-1}\frac{5}{12}\).
Book ke Example 7 ki tarah right triangle (\(x, y, r\)) bana kar \(\cos\alpha\) nikalenge.
Phir half-angle identity \(\cos\frac{\alpha}{2} = \sqrt{\frac{1 + \cos\alpha}{2}}\) se jawab milega. Calculator ki zaroorat nahi, sirf triangle aur identity.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\cos\left(\frac{1}{2}\cot^{-1}\frac{5}{12}\right)\).
Maloom karna: is ki exact value.
Tareeqa: \(\cot^{-1}\frac{5}{12} = \alpha\) maan kar \(x = 5, y = 12\) se \(r\) aur \(\cos\alpha\) nikalenge, phir cosine ki half-angle identity lagayenge.

Angle ko naam dein
\[\cot^{-1}\frac{5}{12} = \alpha \Rightarrow \cot\alpha = \frac{5}{12}\]
\[0 < \alpha < \frac{\pi}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\cot^{-1}\) ki range \((0, \pi)\) hai. Cotangent positive hai to angle pehle quadrant mein hai. Is se \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) bhi \(0\) aur \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) ke beech hoga.

Reference triangle
\[x = 5, \; y = 12\]
\[r = \sqrt{5^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{169} = 13\]
\[\cos\alpha = \frac{x}{r} = \frac{5}{13}\]
Kyun: \(\cot\alpha = \frac{x}{y}\) (base/perpendicular), is liye \(x = 5\) aur \(y = 12\) liye. Pythagoras se hypotenuse \(r = 13\). Phir \(\cos\alpha = \frac{x}{r}\).

Half-angle identity
\[\cos\frac{\alpha}{2} = \sqrt{\frac{1 + \cos\alpha}{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{\dfrac{1 + \frac{5}{13}}{2}} = \sqrt{\frac{18}{26}}\]
\[= \sqrt{\frac{9}{13}} = \frac{3}{\sqrt{13}}\]
Kyun: Yeh identity \(\cos\alpha = 2\cos^2\frac{\alpha}{2} - 1\) se aati hai. \(1 + \frac{5}{13} = \frac{18}{13}\), 2 se divide kiya to \(\frac{18}{26} = \frac{9}{13}\). \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) pehle quadrant mein hai, is liye positive root liya.
Dhyan dein: Bohat se students \(1 - \cos\alpha\) wala formula laga dete hain; woh \(\sin\frac{\alpha}{2}\) ke liye hai. Cosine ke liye \(1 + \cos\alpha\).

Tasdeeq
\[2\left(\frac{9}{13}\right) - 1 = \frac{5}{13} = \cos\alpha \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Jawab ko square kar ke \(2\cos^2\frac{\alpha}{2} - 1\) mein rakha to wapas \(\cos\alpha\) mila. Jawab pakka hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (ii) Without using calculator find the value of the following: \(\sec\left(\frac{1}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{7}{25}\right)\).
blocks.explanation:
Pehle poore angle ko naam: \(\alpha = \sin^{-1}\frac{7}{25}\). Triangle se \(\cos\alpha\) nikalenge.
Secant ki koi alag half-angle identity yaad karne ki zaroorat nahi: pehle \(\cos\frac{\alpha}{2}\) nikalenge, phir us ka reciprocal le lenge.
Yani \(\sec\frac{\alpha}{2} = \frac{1}{\cos(\alpha/2)}\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sec\left(\frac{1}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{7}{25}\right)\).
Maloom karna: is ki exact value.
Tareeqa: \(\sin^{-1}\frac{7}{25} = \alpha\) maan kar \(y = 7, r = 25\) se \(x\) aur \(\cos\alpha\) nikalenge; phir \(\cos\frac{\alpha}{2}\) aur us ka reciprocal.

Angle ko naam dein
\[\sin^{-1}\frac{7}{25} = \alpha \Rightarrow \sin\alpha = \frac{7}{25}\]
\[0 < \alpha < \frac{\pi}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\sin^{-1}\) ki range \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) hai; sine positive hai to pehla quadrant.

Reference triangle
\[y = 7, \; r = 25\]
\[x = \sqrt{625 - 49} = \sqrt{576} = 24\]
\[\cos\alpha = \frac{24}{25}\]
Kyun: \(\sin\alpha = \frac{y}{r}\) (perpendicular/hypotenuse). Base Pythagoras se: \(x = \sqrt{r^2 - y^2}\). 7-24-25 bhi ek mashhoor right triangle hai.

Half-angle identity
\[\cos\frac{\alpha}{2} = \sqrt{\dfrac{1 + \frac{24}{25}}{2}} = \sqrt{\frac{49}{50}}\]
\[= \frac{7}{\sqrt{50}}\]
Kyun: \(1 + \frac{24}{25} = \frac{49}{25}\), 2 se divide: \(\frac{49}{50}\). \(\sqrt{49} = 7\). \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) acute hai, is liye positive root.

Reciprocal lein
\[\sec\frac{\alpha}{2} = \frac{\sqrt{50}}{7} = \frac{5\sqrt{2}}{7}\]
Kyun: \(\sec\theta = \frac{1}{\cos\theta}\), yani fraction ko palat diya. \(\sqrt{50} = \sqrt{25 \cdot 2} = 5\sqrt{2}\); answer key \(\frac{\sqrt{50}}{7}\) likhti hai, dono barabar hain.
Dhyan dein: Aakhir mein reciprocal lena na bhoolen; \(\frac{7}{\sqrt{50}}\) cosine hai, secant nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[2\left(\frac{49}{50}\right) - 1 = \frac{48}{50} = \frac{24}{25} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(2\cos^2\frac{\alpha}{2} - 1\) se wapas \(\cos\alpha = \frac{24}{25}\) mila.

blocks.prompt: 4 (iii) Without using calculator find the value of the following: \(\tan\left(\frac{1}{2}\cot^{-1}\frac{24}{7}\right)\).
blocks.explanation:
Poore angle ko naam: \(\alpha = \cot^{-1}\frac{24}{7}\). Triangle se \(\cos\alpha\) milega.
Tangent ki half-angle identity \(\tan\frac{\alpha}{2} = \sqrt{\frac{1 - \cos\alpha}{1 + \cos\alpha}}\) hai: yeh sine wale aur cosine wale half-angle formulas ko divide karne se banti hai.
Is mein sirf ek cheez, \(\cos\alpha\), chahiye; is liye kaam chhota hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\tan\left(\frac{1}{2}\cot^{-1}\frac{24}{7}\right)\).
Maloom karna: is ki exact value.
Tareeqa: \(\cot^{-1}\frac{24}{7} = \alpha\) maan kar \(x = 24, y = 7\) se \(r\) aur \(\cos\alpha\) nikalenge, phir tangent ki half-angle identity.

Angle ko naam dein
\[\cot^{-1}\frac{24}{7} = \alpha \Rightarrow \cot\alpha = \frac{24}{7}\]
\[0 < \alpha < \frac{\pi}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\cot^{-1}\) ki range \((0, \pi)\) hai; positive value ka matlab pehla quadrant.

Half-angle identity
\[\tan\frac{\alpha}{2} = \sqrt{\frac{1 - \cos\alpha}{1 + \cos\alpha}}\]
\[= \sqrt{\dfrac{1/25}{49/25}} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{49}}\]
\[= \frac{1}{7}\]
Kyun: \(1 - \frac{24}{25} = \frac{1}{25}\) aur \(1 + \frac{24}{25} = \frac{49}{25}\). Dono ke neeche 25 hai jo cancel ho gaya, \(\frac{1}{49}\) bacha, jis ka root \(\frac{1}{7}\). \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) acute hai, is liye positive.
Dhyan dein: Upar \(1 - \cos\alpha\) aur neeche \(1 + \cos\alpha\) aata hai; inhein ulat dene se jawab \(7\) aa jayega jo ghalat hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\tan\alpha = \dfrac{2(1/7)}{1 - 1/49} = \frac{2}{7} \cdot \frac{49}{48} = \frac{7}{24}\]
Kyun: Double-angle formula \(\tan\alpha = \frac{2\tan(\alpha/2)}{1 - \tan^2(\alpha/2)}\) se wapas \(\tan\alpha = \frac{7}{24}\) mila, yani \(\cot\alpha = \frac{24}{7}\). Bilkul sahi.

blocks.prompt: 4 (iv) Without using calculator find the value of the following: \(\tan\left(\frac{1}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)\).
blocks.explanation:
Is part mein andar wala angle standard hai: \(\sin^{-1}\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{\pi}{3}\) (Question 1(i) mein yahi nikala tha).
Us ka aadha \(\frac{\pi}{6}\) hai, aur \(\tan\frac{\pi}{6}\) humein zubani yaad hai.
Is liye triangle banane ki zaroorat nahi; seedha raasta behtar hai. Tasdeeq ke liye half-angle identity bhi laga kar dekhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\tan\left(\frac{1}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)\).
Maloom karna: is ki exact value.
Tareeqa: \(\sin^{-1}\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) ki principal value nikalenge, us ka aadha karenge, phir tangent.

Andar wala angle
\[\sin^{-1}\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{\pi}{3}\]
Kyun: \(\sin 60^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\), aur \(\frac{\pi}{3}\) \(\sin^{-1}\) ki range mein hai.

Aadha kar ke tangent lein
\[\tan\left(\frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{\pi}{3}\right) = \tan\frac{\pi}{6}\]
\[= \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{\pi}{3}\) ka aadha \(\frac{\pi}{6}\), yani \(30^\circ\), aur \(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\).
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{1}{2}\) angle par lagta hai, value par nahi. \(\frac{1}{2}\tan\frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) likhna ghalat hoga.

Half-angle identity se tasdeeq
\[\cos\alpha = \frac{1}{2}: \; \sqrt{\dfrac{1 - \frac{1}{2}}{1 + \frac{1}{2}}} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{3}}\]
Kyun: \(\alpha = \frac{\pi}{3}\) ka \(\cos\alpha = \frac{1}{2}\). Parts (i)-(iii) wala aam tareeqa bhi wohi jawab \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) deta hai. Dono raaste ek jagah pohanche.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein yeh jawab \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) label (vi) ke neeche likha hai, (iv) ke neeche nahi. Value bilkul sahi hai, sirf label ghalat hai: yeh part (iv) ka jawab hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (v) Without using calculator find the value of the following: \(\cot\left(\frac{1}{2}\sec^{-1}\frac{2\sqrt{6}}{3}\right)\).
blocks.explanation:
Poore angle ko naam: \(\alpha = \sec^{-1}\frac{2\sqrt{6}}{3}\). Secant ka reciprocal le kar \(\cos\alpha = \frac{\sqrt{6}}{4}\) milega.
Cotangent, tangent ka ulta hai, is liye half-angle formula bhi ulta: \(\cot\frac{\alpha}{2} = \sqrt{\frac{1 + \cos\alpha}{1 - \cos\alpha}}\).
Is part mein radicals (\(\sqrt{6}\)) zyada hain, is liye aakhir mein rationalise (neeche se root hatana) karna parega. Har qadam ahista karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\cot\left(\frac{1}{2}\sec^{-1}\frac{2\sqrt{6}}{3}\right)\).
Maloom karna: is ki exact value.
Tareeqa: \(\sec^{-1}\frac{2\sqrt{6}}{3} = \alpha\) maan kar reciprocal se \(\cos\alpha\) nikalenge, phir \(\cot\frac{\alpha}{2} = \sqrt{\frac{1 + \cos\alpha}{1 - \cos\alpha}}\) lagayenge aur jawab ko saaf karenge.

Angle ko naam dein
\[\sec^{-1}\frac{2\sqrt{6}}{3} = \alpha \Rightarrow \sec\alpha = \frac{2\sqrt{6}}{3}\]
\[0 < \alpha < \frac{\pi}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\sec^{-1}\) ki range \(\left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right) \cup \left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right]\) hai. \(2\sqrt{6} = \sqrt{24}\), jo \(\sqrt{9} = 3\) se bara hai, yani \(\sec\alpha > 1\); is liye \(\alpha\) pehle quadrant mein hai aur \(0\) nahi hai.

\(\cos\alpha\) nikalein
\[\cos\alpha = \frac{3}{2\sqrt{6}} = \frac{3\sqrt{6}}{12} = \frac{\sqrt{6}}{4}\]
Kyun: Secant ka reciprocal cosine hai, to fraction palat diya. Neeche se root hatane ke liye upar neeche \(\sqrt{6}\) se multiply kiya: neeche \(2 \cdot 6 = 12\), phir 3 se chhota kiya.

Half-angle identity
\[\cot\frac{\alpha}{2} = \sqrt{\frac{1 + \cos\alpha}{1 - \cos\alpha}}\]
\[= \sqrt{\dfrac{1 + \frac{\sqrt{6}}{4}}{1 - \frac{\sqrt{6}}{4}}} = \sqrt{\frac{4 + \sqrt{6}}{4 - \sqrt{6}}}\]
Kyun: \(\cot = \frac{1}{\tan}\), is liye tangent wale formula ka upar neeche ulta ho gaya. Andar upar neeche dono ko 4 se multiply kiya taake chhote fractions khatam ho jayein.
Dhyan dein: Cotangent ke liye upar \(1 + \cos\alpha\) hai; tangent wala formula yahan lagana jawab ko ulta kar dega.

Root ke andar rationalise karein
\[\frac{4 + \sqrt{6}}{4 - \sqrt{6}} = \frac{(4 + \sqrt{6})^2}{16 - 6}\]
\[= \frac{22 + 8\sqrt{6}}{10} = \frac{11 + 4\sqrt{6}}{5}\]
Kyun: Neeche \(4 - \sqrt{6}\) hai; is ke conjugate \(4 + \sqrt{6}\) se upar neeche multiply kiya. Neeche \((a - b)(a + b) = a^2 - b^2 = 16 - 6 = 10\). Upar \((4 + \sqrt{6})^2 = 16 + 8\sqrt{6} + 6 = 22 + 8\sqrt{6}\). Phir 2 se chhota kiya.

Jawab aur tasdeeq
\[\cot\frac{\alpha}{2} = \sqrt{\frac{11 + 4\sqrt{6}}{5}} \approx 2.04\]
Kyun: Yahi answer key ki shakal hai. Isay \(\frac{4 + \sqrt{6}}{\sqrt{10}}\) bhi likh sakte hain, kyunke \(\frac{(4 + \sqrt{6})^2}{10} = \frac{11 + 4\sqrt{6}}{5}\). Andaza: \(\frac{6.449}{3.162} \approx 2.04\), dono shaklein barabar.

blocks.prompt: 4 (v) [second part printed as (v); the answer key calls it (vi)] Without using calculator find the value of the following: \(\csc\left(\frac{1}{2}\cot^{-1}\frac{4}{3}\right)\).
blocks.explanation:
Kitab ne is part par bhi '(v)' chhap diya hai, halanke yeh chhata part hai; hum printed label rakhte hain aur neeche note diya hai.
Poore angle ko naam: \(\alpha = \cot^{-1}\frac{4}{3}\). Mashhoor 3-4-5 triangle se \(\cos\alpha = \frac{4}{5}\).
Phir \(\sin\frac{\alpha}{2} = \sqrt{\frac{1 - \cos\alpha}{2}}\) nikal kar reciprocal lenge, kyunke cosecant sine ka ulta hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\csc\left(\frac{1}{2}\cot^{-1}\frac{4}{3}\right)\).
Maloom karna: is ki exact value.
Tareeqa: \(\cot^{-1}\frac{4}{3} = \alpha\) maan kar \(x = 4, y = 3\) se \(r\) aur \(\cos\alpha\) nikalenge; phir \(\sin\frac{\alpha}{2}\) aur us ka reciprocal.

Angle ko naam dein
\[\cot^{-1}\frac{4}{3} = \alpha \Rightarrow \cot\alpha = \frac{4}{3}\]
\[0 < \alpha < \frac{\pi}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\cot^{-1}\) ki range \((0, \pi)\) hai; positive value ka matlab pehla quadrant. To \(\frac{\alpha}{2}\) bhi acute hai.

Reference triangle
\[x = 4, \; y = 3\]
\[r = \sqrt{16 + 9} = 5\]
\[\cos\alpha = \frac{4}{5}\]
Kyun: \(\cot\alpha = \frac{x}{y}\) se base 4 aur perpendicular 3. Hypotenuse 5 (3-4-5 triangle). \(\cos\alpha = \frac{x}{r}\).

Half-angle identity
\[\sin\frac{\alpha}{2} = \sqrt{\frac{1 - \cos\alpha}{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{\dfrac{1 - \frac{4}{5}}{2}} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{10}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{10}}\]
Kyun: Yeh identity \(\cos\alpha = 1 - 2\sin^2\frac{\alpha}{2}\) se aati hai. \(1 - \frac{4}{5} = \frac{1}{5}\), 2 se divide: \(\frac{1}{10}\). Acute angle, is liye positive root.
Dhyan dein: Sine ke liye \(1 - \cos\alpha\), cosine ke liye \(1 + \cos\alpha\); in dono ko mila dena aam ghalti hai.

Reciprocal lein
\[\csc\frac{\alpha}{2} = \sqrt{10}\]
Kyun: \(\csc\theta = \frac{1}{\sin\theta}\); \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{10}}\) ka reciprocal \(\sqrt{10}\) hai.

Tasdeeq
\[1 - 2\left(\frac{1}{10}\right) = \frac{4}{5} = \cos\alpha \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(1 - 2\sin^2\frac{\alpha}{2}\) mein jawab rakha to wapas \(\cos\alpha = \frac{4}{5}\) mila.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Question 4 mein label (v) do dafa chhapa hai. Yeh doosra (v) asal mein chhata part hai aur is ka label (vi) hona chahiye tha; answer key isay (vi) hi kehti hai aur us ka jawab \(\sqrt{10}\) sahi hai. Hum ne printed label rakha hai aur reference 4(v) (second) diya hai.
